headline: Reported AI-agent attack on Taiwan nuclear regulator
body: Three stories with mixed effects. Roundups citing Reuters said a China-linked actor used autonomous AI agents to probe Taiwan's nuclear safety regulator. The report is not independently verified, so it was weighted with caution, but it still raised Catastrophic Risk and lifted Self-Destruction. Google said the Gemini app passed one billion monthly users, a sign of broad public acceptance that lowers Tech Backlash and Reversion. In Germany, HateAid filed a criminal complaint arguing Ray-Ban Meta glasses are illegal covert recording devices; pushing back on surveillance trims 1984. Horizon Balance slipped to -1.98.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.2 came from the reported Taiwan attack (+0.16); Reversion -0.2 came from Gemini's one billion users (-0.21); 1984 -0.1 came from the HateAid complaint (-0.13).
